name: project-orchestration
description: Diagnose, establish, reconcile, and evolve reproducible project operations.

interface.shortDescription: Establish and evolve sustainable project operations.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose a new or existing project, progressively specify an approved operating-state delta, preserve artifact authority, establish bounded ownership and evidence, and reconcile or evolve that state without discarding existing work.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project to diagnose this project's operating state, progressively specify the approved delta, and apply it only after freeze approval.
